airports.name: Albany County (1986)
airports.location_note: Delta printed p.260 identifies ALB as Albany County; historical name retained. The AirNav FAA record matches the named airfield and predates 1986 in its activation field. Activation metadata is not treated as an exact historical opening date. Current estimated FAA reference coordinates reproduced by AirNav provide approximate same-airfield markers, not 1986 terminal, stand, runway threshold, layout or aircraft positions.
